worktree_dir.description: Directory of new worktrees, relative to the repository root or absolute; a ticket checks out at `<worktree_dir>/<branch_name>`.

auto_setup_merge.description: `false` sets `branch.autoSetupMerge=false` in the root repository before creating a worktree, so run branches have no upstream and push with `push.default=current`; `true` leaves Git alone but does not revert an earlier change.

shared.description: Isolating runtimes only: run clones borrow the parent repository's objects (git clone --shared) instead of copying them. Faster and smaller, but never prune or repack the parent with -d while a run is open.
